label: no
controls_available: Difficulty 4 uses a 15x9 map (135 parcels), 20 boundary-warp steps, 12 displaced parcels, a 24-parcel-change budget, winner margin 1, population tolerance 1 around an ideal population of 15, and three disjoint balanced exchanges of two parcels each.

The simplified surface is mouse-driven: click one visible parcel to select it, then click one canton seal to assign that parcel through the canton_proxy_button proxy. The full-mode brush requirement is inactive.

UNDO reverses the last recorded assignment or stroke; CERTIFY CHARTER submits the current assignment and is administrative. The environment declares synchronous execution with a 240-second play allowance, a 0 ms observation window, and one frame per observation.
autonomous_processes: No outcome-affecting autonomous process: after event handlers finish, assignment, selected parcel, history, spent change budget, event transcript, and evaluation metrics remain unchanged until another input event.

Presentation-only CSS transitions run after some renders or hover states (parcel fill/fill-opacity for 0.1 s and canton-row background/transform/border transitions for 0.12 s); they do not change the assignment or verifier outcome and therefore cannot witness clause (iii).
grouped_control_modes: D_assign: all outcome-affecting simplified parcel-to-canton assignment events across parcels, cantons, seeds, rounds, and attempts, recorded as assign/canton_proxy_button.
D_undo: all outcome-affecting undo_button reversals of the most recent assignment history entry.
Parcel-selection clicks are preparatory and not outcome-affecting; CERTIFY CHARTER is administrative and is not a control mode for the real-time witness.

clause_i.reason: For D_assign and D_undo, a no-input delay leaves the outcome-relevant state unchanged, so there is no delayed-optimal action whose choice is produced by a visible evolving task state. The map may require ordinary screenshot-based planning, but that static visual dependence is not the temporal action-history distinction required by the conjunction.

clause_ii.reason: The visible parcel polygons, current canton coloring, guild house marks, canton seals, goal, and change budget are available in one endpoint screenshot. The configured 0 ms window and one frame are sufficient for the static visual solution; no chronological window is needed. This does not repair the failed autonomous-evolution clause.

clause_iii.reason: There is no legitimate D, positive Delta, and 0 < tau < Delta for which the task changes autonomously while success remains possible and an assignment or undo loses value. Simplified assignment and undo mutate state synchronously only inside click handlers. Waiting can at most consume the global play allowance, which the frozen definition excludes as a mere deadline effect; the CSS transitions are presentation-only.

common_visible_process: None. The generator creates a fixed seeded parcel/assignment instance, and the browser keeps the outcome-relevant model stationary between inputs. The only no-input visual changes are short CSS presentation transitions unrelated to the charter outcome, so no common visible autonomous process can witness all three clauses.

pre_run.reason: The mathematical label is already No because clause (iii) fails. Source review also finds no autonomous outcome phase: every assignment change is an explicit UI action and certification is administrative, so a pre-run rate is not applicable.

source_evidence.claim: Real-time requires the same grouped control mode, positive delay, bounded visible window, and an autonomous task-state change that strictly degrades an action; unrelated animation and mere deadline loss do not qualify.

The exact difficulty-4 profile is 15x9 with 20 boundary warps, 12 displaced parcels, 24 changes, tolerance 1, three exchange bundles of size 2; simplified interaction is click parcel then click seal, and observation_window_ms is 0 with one frame.
The environment exposes a one-frame 0 ms observation window, mouse/keyboard action types, synchronous execution, and a 240-second play allowance.

The generator consumes the supplied difficulty parameters, constructs seeded static initial and target assignments, and exports visible parcels/adjacency plus private target data; it contains no task-clock evolution.

Simplified parcel selection and seal clicks are the only path to recordAssignment, which synchronously mutates assignment, history, spent budget, and events; no timer or autonomous update is installed.
Undo and certification are explicit button handlers; certification posts the current metrics, while render initializes a stationary model and binds only input handlers.
The only time-based styling is short fill/opacity and panel hover transitions, with no CSS animation that changes task state or outcome.

The grader requires simplified assign events, replays the explicit transcript and budget, and determines success solely from the final assignment metrics; no elapsed-time or transient-state condition is graded.
The verifier loads the exported result and invokes the independent replay grader; certification is the administrative submission boundary.
The solver reads the private target only as implementation evidence, performs explicit repair actions, captures the solved state, and then certifies; it has no autonomous outcome phase.
